tagline.en: Unlimited data only, priced by the day, hotspot capped
tagline.zh: 只卖不限量，按天计价，热点有限制

description.en: Holafly sells one thing: unlimited data, priced by the day, for up to 90 days in 160+ destinations. No data counter, no topping up mid-trip, no choosing between 5GB and 10GB. You pay for that convenience. Per-day cost runs well above capped plans, the hotspot is limited or off on some destinations, and heavy use in the hundreds of gigabytes can be throttled under fair use.
description.zh: Holafly 只卖一种东西：不限量流量，按天计价，最长 90 天，覆盖 160+ 目的地。没有流量计数器，不用半路加购，也不用在 5GB 和 10GB 之间纠结。代价是这个方便要花钱：日均价明显高于限量套餐，部分目的地热点受限或不可用，用量到数百 GB 会按公平使用条款降速。

details.en:
Holafly's entire catalogue is built around one promise: never think about gigabytes again. Instead of data buckets, you buy a duration — 5 to 90 days, selectable day by day — and the data is unlimited for that window. That pricing model shines on long single-country stays: a month of working remotely in Spain or Portugal with daily video calls costs a flat rate, with no anxiety about hitting a cap mid-call. Two caveats from the plan terms: hotspot tethering is supported on most destinations but a few limit sharing speed, and a fair-use policy applies — after very high consumption (typically hundreds of GB in a billing cycle) speeds may be reduced, so it is unlimited for travel use, not a home-broadband replacement. Installation is via QR from the web store or app, activation is automatic on first connection, and plans can be extended mid-trip from the app.

Note that Holafly's per-day cost is higher than capped plans from budget providers — the premium buys the removal of the data counter, not a cheaper gigabyte.

Community single-user hands-on (2026-09, unverified): 2-day unlimited pass ~¥21 CNY; 1GB/month emergency data plus WeChat-specific data on day one. Nominal carrier CMHK but traffic actually lands in Singapore (broadcast + datacenter IPs) — mediocre IP quality and speeds. Verdict: fine as an emergency backup, not a daily driver.
details.zh:
Holafly 的整个产品目录围绕一个承诺：再也不用盯着流量数字。你买的不是流量桶，而是一段时间——5 到 90 天逐日可选——期间流量不限量。这种计价方式在单国长住场景最为划算：在西班牙或葡萄牙远程办公一个月、每天开视频会议，也只付一个固定价，不用怕会议中途断网。

条款里有两个注意点：多数目的地支持热点共享，但少数国家会限制共享速度；同时适用公平使用政策——单周期用量极高（通常数百 GB）后可能降速，所以它是旅行意义上的不限量，不是家庭宽带替代品。

安装通过官网或 App 的二维码完成，首次联网自动激活，行程中可在 App 内直接延期。

需要留意的是，Holafly 的日均成本高于预算型供应商的限量套餐——溢价买的是「流量清零焦虑」的消失，而不是更便宜的每 GB 单价。

社区单用户实测（2026-09，未核实）：2 天不限量套餐约 21 元人民币；每月有 1GB 应急流量，首日附带微信专属流量。名义上走 CMHK，实际落地在新加坡（广播+机房 IP），IP 质量一般、速率不尽人意。定位：应急备用卡可以，主力使用不推荐。

bestFor.en: Stays of a week or more in one country, and anyone on video calls all day who would rather not watch a counter.
bestFor.zh: 在一个国家待一周以上，或者整天开视频会、不想盯着流量数字的人。

en: No speed throttling on most plans

plansNote.en: Holafly sells duration-based unlimited plans (e.g. 5/10/15/20/30... days) with prices set per destination and season. Its storefront is behind a bot challenge, so per-destination day prices are not republished here — check the official site for live rates.
plansNote.zh: Holafly 按有效期售卖不限量套餐（如 5/10/15/20/30 天等），价格随目的地与季节变动。其商店有反爬验证，此处不转载逐目的地日价——请以官网实时价为准。

en: Genuinely unlimited, so the counter stops being something you think about
Duration chosen day by day, up to 90
Support replies fast, and in person, any hour
Priced per day, which suits long remote-work stretches better than buying gigabytes
zh: 真的不限量，不用再算还剩多少
有效期按天自选，最长 90 天
客服响应快，是真人，全天在线
按天计价，长住远程办公比买 GB 更合适

en: Per-day cost is higher than capped plans from budget brands
Fair-use throttling kicks in at extreme usage
Hotspot speed capped on some destinations
No cheap fixed-data tier for light users
Community tests put the exit in Singapore broadcast and datacenter ranges, with middling speeds (unverified)
zh: 日均价高于低价品牌的限量套餐
用量极端时会被公平使用条款限速
部分目的地热点速度受限
没有给轻度用户的便宜小流量档
社区实测出口在新加坡广播和机房段，速度一般（未核实）

country.en: varies (documented routing via China Mobile and other undisclosed networks)
country.zh: 不定（有实测记录经中国移动及未公开网络出口）

note.en: USENIX Security 2025 measured Holafly traffic traversing China Mobile's network in mainland China plus other undisclosed carriers; Holafly's own traffic-routing FAQ confirms home-routed roaming and that users may see foreign IPs. Exact exit IP nature (residential/datacenter) is not characterized.
note.zh: USENIX 2025 研究实测 Holafly 流量经中国大陆中国移动及未披露网络路由；官方 traffic-routing FAQ 承认 home-routed 漫游、会出现外国 IP。出口 IP 具体性质（住宅/机房）无公开数据。
